positive_derivation_path: choose recipient i among three coordinates
affine conservation requires total transverse compensation -1
minimal completed compensation requires exactly one of the other two coordinates changes by -1 and the other by 0
therefore displacement is e_i-e_j for a unique donor j != i

redundancy_audit.additive_inversion: (e_i-e_j)=-(e_j-e_i), so inverse descriptions are not extra states

why_not_more: without adjacent/minimal single-unit compensation, each recipient admits infinitely many integer transverse decompositions (t,-1-t); six is not implied by sheet+unit+integrality alone
